comment: Red team 10_4 (threat_behind_thin_wall, aimed at #9,#1,#8): A thin free wall sits straight ahead. The left side is both shorter and hides the right-rear threat. While rounding the left end, threat-watching and the slice-the-pie look-round compete, so the nearest man may skip the end or stare into the 20 cm wall up close. Broke 1 (check, choice, members): #1 wall stare. First: #1 hedgehog n4 R1 s1 t=18.5s - P at W1.
